objective: Capture the live prohibition criterion verbatim as a fixture, determine whether criteria_addressed misclassifies the phrasings the planner actually emits, and apply Ruling B17-R2 (doubt abstains, never presence) if the misread is confirmed.
evidence: HANDOVER.md §4.2 B17 — OPEN; 'the coverage check cannot read a prohibition'
docs/handover-review.md §34 — the form branch's two abstentions on record
ARCH-20260922-026 — the prohibition scenario and its pre-registration
ARCH-20260922-027 — the live run and its per-criterion shape table
autornd/graph/checks.py — criteria_addressed shape classification and the prohibition token test
AGENTS.md convention 2 — free checks before paid calls
AGENTS.md convention 21 — shape variance that preserves information is coerced; exhibits precede leniency
AGENTS.md convention 22 — an instrument's test simulates the condition it watches, end to end
AGENTS.md convention 27 — a repetition of a plan-dependent contrast is a second sample, never a confirmation
constraints: Free. No paid call, no key, no network. This command reads a committed trace and writes a fixture.
Read the -027 trace and quote three things VERBATIM: each criterion, the significant terms the check extracted, and the forbidden tokens it extracted. Do not paraphrase, summarise or reconstruct.

State which happened: (a) no prohibition-shaped criterion was emitted at all; (b) one was emitted and classified prohibition correctly; (c) one was emitted and classified presence or form. These are three different findings.
If (a): the scenario engineering failed, B17 stays open for a different reason, and the fix is the scenario — say so, do not touch the check.
If (c): apply Ruling B17-R2 as written — on doubt, abstain; never default to presence. Do not redesign the shapes; they are ruled.
Apply the doubt-direction change ONLY if the fixture confirms a misread. If the fixture shows correct classification, the fixture stands alone as a regression test and checks.py is untouched.
Do NOT broaden the classifier's pattern as a fix. Detection recall is a separate, later question; the ruled change is the direction of doubt.
Do NOT compare classifier behaviour across runs as though the input were constant. B16 regenerates criteria per run (convention 27). Report detections, not a change in the classifier.

Report whether a form-shaped criterion existed in this run and whether it was classified form, presence or prohibition. If a second shape was also missed, say so — one defect class, not two, unless the mechanisms differ.
The fixture asserts the exact classification of the exact wording (convention 22). It must fail if the classification changes for the wrong reason.
Prove any applied change by breaking it: a criterion the classifier should abstain on, and one it should test, each simulated end to end.
Do not touch the workflow, any prompt, or any other check.
Keep the diff small and confined to checks.py and the fixture.
acceptance_criteria: The criterion, its extracted significant terms, and its extracted forbidden tokens are all quoted verbatim.
The outcome is stated as (a), (b) or (c), with the evidence.
A committed fixture asserts the exact classification of the exact wording.
If (c): Ruling B17-R2 is applied, and a test demonstrates that a doubtful shape abstains rather than defaulting to presence.
If (a): B17 stays open and the finding is the scenario, not the check — stated plainly.
No pattern was broadened and no shape was redesigned; assert this in the response.
Suite count reported before and after.

verification.expected: All pass; count reported before and after.

verification.command: .venv/bin/python3 -m pytest tests/ -q -k 'coverage_shapes or prohibition or abstain'
verification.expected: The fixture and any doubt-direction test pass.

rollback: Revert the commit; the classifier returns to its previous doubt direction and the fixture is removed with it.
assumptions: The -027 trace is committed and quotes the planner's emitted criteria. If the trace does not carry the criteria verbatim, return BLOCKED naming what is missing rather than reconstructing.
questions: If (c) is confirmed, should a phrasing corpus be built from committed traces before any further paid run? If so, ask the owner for the ruling on whether committed traces may substitute for a fresh run.
Does any downstream report present a coverage pass rate across runs with differing criteria? If yes, that is a separate convention-27 defect and should be named.

preconditions.expected: B17 present and OPEN. If CLOSED, return NO_ACTION citing the commit that closed it.

preconditions.command: ls docs/traces/ | grep -i prohibition; ls docs/traces/ | tail -5
preconditions.expected: Locate the -027 trace by name; record it. If nothing matches, return BLOCKED naming the glob searched.
The -027 response file exists; record the shape table it carries.
Green at the current count before the change.
